name: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Ltd
description: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Ltd (ONGC) is India's largest crude oil and natural gas exploration and production (E&P) company, contributing approximately 71% to domestic crude oil production and 84% to domestic natural gas output. A Maharatna CPSE, ONGC operates major offshore assets in the Mumbai High and Krishna Godavari (KG) basins alongside global upstream assets through ONGC Videsh Ltd (OVL).

company_profile.summary: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Ltd (ONGC) is India's largest crude oil and natural gas exploration and production (E&P) company, contributing approximately 71% to domestic crude oil production and 84% to domestic natural gas output. A Maharatna CPSE, ONGC operates major offshore assets in the Mumbai High and Krishna Godavari (KG) basins alongside global upstream assets through ONGC Videsh Ltd (OVL).

revenue_breakup.desc: Crude oil pumped from Mumbai High, KG Basin, Assam, and Gujarat sold to domestic refiners.
Piped natural gas sold at regulated APM and HPHT prices to fertilizer plants, power utilities, and city gas networks.
LPG, C2-C3 fraction, aromatic naphtha, and kerosene extracted at gas processing plants.

company_profile.geographic_mix: Domestic (India): 78% • International (ONGC Videsh E&P assets across 15 countries): 22%
moats_and_strengths: Dominant upstream sovereign player controlling India's most prolific petroleum and natural gas basins.
Integrated downstream presence through ownership of Hindustan Petroleum (HPCL) and Mangalore Refinery (MRPL).
World-class deepwater offshore drilling expertise demonstrated in the complex KG-DWN-98/2 deepwater block.
Significant beneficiary of any international crude oil price rally with low lifting production costs (~$8-$10/barrel).
company_profile.order_book_or_capacity: Hydrocarbon Reserves: 2,000+ MMT • Annual Production: ~40 MMT of oil equivalent (O+OEG)

bullish_triggers: Ramp-up of crude oil and natural gas production from the deepwater KG-DWN-98/2 block in the Bay of Bengal.
Domestic natural gas pricing reforms establishing premium floors for deepwater, ultra-deepwater, and high-pressure fields.
Generous dividend payouts supported by robust operating cash flows.
bearish_risks: Windfall taxes and special additional excise duties imposed by the government during crude price rallies.
Natural reservoir decline in mature brownfield offshore fields requiring expensive enhanced oil recovery (EOR) capex.

liquidation_safety.pledge_deadline: 9:00 PM on T-day (Mandatory CDSL/NSDL OTP authorization)
